notes: User explicitly requests rolling latest: add pull_policy: always after generation; do not add updater services.
Use the official Halo apps/child service form pattern restricted to postgresql. Remove the generator's duplicate top-level PANEL_DB_HOST field; it is already declared in the child selector.
The database is managed by 1Panel, not this Compose. No postgres service or cross-project depends_on.
Command only encodes DATABASE_URL then runs the official deploy/server sequence. No source modification or host lifecycle scripts.
Application image runs as root; no host ownership hook needed for these two mounts.
Specialized labels use English fallback outside Chinese; common database labels copied from Halo.
Logo captured from the official PNG through Playwright MCP.
Package metadata version latest denotes a rolling channel, not an upstream release number. No automatic replacement of running containers.

services.name: voicehub
command:
DATABASE_URL="$$(node -e 'const e=process.env; for (const k of ["PANEL_DB_HOST","PANEL_DB_PORT","PANEL_DB_NAME","PANEL_DB_USER","PANEL_DB_USER_PASSWORD","JWT_SECRET"]) if (!e[k]) throw Error("Missing "+k); if (Buffer.byteLength(e.JWT_SECRET)<32) throw Error("JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 bytes"); if (!/^\d+$/.test(e.PANEL_DB_PORT) || Number(e.PANEL_DB_PORT)<1 || Number(e.PANEL_DB_PORT)>65535) throw Error("Invalid database port"); const u=new URL("postgresql://placeholder"); u.hostname=e.PANEL_DB_HOST; u.port=e.PANEL_DB_PORT; u.pathname="/"+encodeURIComponent(e.PANEL_DB_NAME); u.username=encodeURIComponent(e.PANEL_DB_USER); u.password=encodeURIComponent(e.PANEL_DB_USER_PASSWORD); u.searchParams.set("sslmode","disable"); process.stdout.write(u.href)')"
export DATABASE_URL
node scripts/deploy.js
exec node .output/server/index.mjs
